caption: The drawing depicts a decorative doorway set in a wall with a textured brown double wooden door featuring vertically wavy patterns. The doorway is framed by two pinkish-red pillars and matching horizontal trim, with a curved arch of the same color above the doors. The wall surrounding the door is a pale beige with hints of blue and light wear, creating an aged appearance. Above the arch, there is a small, rectangular window or niche framed in pinkish-red with a scalloped border, and topped by a fan-shaped ornament in a similar color. On either side of the window are ornamental vase-like shapes painted in red, each holding stylized blue and red flowers with green stems and leaves. The ground in front of the door consists of rectangular tiles in shades of brown. There is a signature and date in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Restoration Drawing: Main Doorway, with Decorations, Mission House
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
